task: repair only incomplete current data roots before Desktop and CLI startup

conformance.reason: The existing lifecycle authority and stable Runtime states remain unchanged; this only repairs the current data root before the existing start path continues.

rows.requirement: A partial current data root can be repaired in place by creating missing standard directories, missing current tables, and explicitly safe additive columns; the operation is idempotent and creates no backup or schema-version record.
implementation: Final root inspection and in-place additive database preparation
automated_tests: Partial-root, missing-table, safe-column, idempotence, and incompatible-schema tests
runtime_scenarios: Start with an empty nest.db and leftover runtime control files
platform_conditions: CPython 3.9.25 repository environment and isolated SQLite data roots

rows.requirement: Desktop, installed CLI controller calls, source CLI start, and source CLI serve use the same lifecycle-owned preparation before Runtime snapshot initialization; existing OFFLINE/PREFLIGHT/FAILED behavior remains unchanged.
implementation: Lifecycle data-home preparation callback at the existing RuntimeSupervisor start boundary
automated_tests: Runtime record and Desktop data-home state parsing/start tests
runtime_scenarios: A repaired root receives its initial authoritative OFFLINE Runtime snapshot and can continue startup
platform_conditions: Desktop packaged CLI and source CLI share the injected lifecycle facade

rows.requirement: Unexpected tables, incompatible constraints, unreadable databases, unsafe column additions, malformed Runtime snapshots, and unrelated legacy roots still stop with an explicit error without automatic backup, deletion, or broad migration.
implementation: Existing legacy/corrupt rejection paths retained; only the narrow additive repair state is admitted
automated_tests: Existing legacy recovery and Runtime snapshot safety tests plus new negative cases
runtime_scenarios: An unsupported schema remains blocked and the old explicit recovery action remains user-triggered
platform_conditions: No external service or model validation is required for the data preparation step
